newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl to hold news conference on 0930 GMT Friday.
newsitem.headline: Kohl to hold news conference on 0930 GMT Friday.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl will hold a news conference at 0930 GMT on Friday, the government press office said on Thursday.
The news conference is a regular event in Kohl's diary, and his last appearance before journalists before he heads to the Austrian Alps for his summer holidays.
Kohl's news conference will be closely watched by foreign exchange traders still seeking clarity over Bonn's attitude towards a bout of weakness in the mark.

Kohl's cabinet issued a statement on Wednesday which played down recent foreign exchange market moves, saying sharp gains by the dollar and sterling reflected economic fundamentals and speculation ahead of European economic and monetary union.

But, beyond saying the German government was in close touch with its partners in the G7 group of rich industrialised countries, the statement gave no indication that Bonn would use anything more than words to defend the mark.
Finance Minister Theo Waigel also sought to play down the moves: "Short term currency fluctuations are no grounds for worry," he told a banking conference on Wednesday evening.
Forex dealers were unimpressed by the verbal intervention, and the dollar nudged back over 1.80 marks in early trading on Thursday before falling back slightly.
